description: Authorizes a refund of a payment. Tiers, in order: refuse when the payment source says the payment is not refundable; approve when the source confirms it is refundable and a signed manager approval covers the exact amount (tier 2); reject otherwise. The caller cannot declare any fact. Tier 1 (automatic approval within a threshold) is not included: the validator requires a signed approval on every approve rule.

outcome.reason: Refund refused. The payment source does not confirm the payment is refundable for this amount.
Tier 2: the payment source confirms the payment is refundable, and a signed manager approval covers this exact amount.
